content.short: Hive Intelligence is an AI-powered Web3 data platform delivering actionable on-chain analytics and intelligence for Mantle ecosystem participants.
content.description: Hive Intelligence is an AI-driven analytics platform that transforms raw blockchain data into actionable intelligence for traders, investors, and protocol teams. Using machine learning models trained on on-chain data, Hive provides predictive insights on market trends, wallet behavior patterns, and protocol health metrics. The platform covers Mantle Network data, offering dashboard tools, API access, and automated alert systems that help ecosystem participants make better-informed decisions about their activities on Mantle.
